steps.title: RRST (breathing resistance)
steps.instructions: In the Physio Recorder fill in Participant and Session, pick RRST, click 1 Check signals and wait for green; ask for one or two test breaths through the mouthpiece and check that the Flow trace shows them. Then press Start here: RRST opens. Type the values below when it asks. Recording starts by itself and stops a few seconds after RRST finishes. Press Done when the Last recording panel shows PASS.
